settings.title: Settings

categories.globalSaveHint: Reload and Save apply to global form-owned settings. Immediate and embedded-panel actions are independent.
categories.immediateActionHint: Immediate action: this change is applied independently of the global Save button.
categories.childOwnedActionHint: This embedded panel owns its actions. Its buttons do not wait for the global Save button.

catalog.policyDesc: Configure one global policy or a provider-specific override for each registered catalog provider.
catalog.overrideGlobalPolicy: Override the global policy for this provider
catalog.pickerOpenSyncPolicy: Sync when the model picker opens
catalog.providerStatusDesc: Status is read from the local catalog authority. Manual refresh is an independent action and may contact only the selected provider.
catalog.pendingAvailable: A refreshed catalog snapshot is ready for review.
catalog.cacheDesc: Cache controls are provider-neutral and do not delete credentials or chat history.
catalog.cacheClearCurrentConfirm: Clear the current credential-scoped model cache for {provider}? Credentials and chat history will be kept.
catalog.cacheClearAllConfirm: Clear all model catalog caches for {provider}? Credentials and chat history will be kept.
catalog.cacheClearCurrentSuccess: Cleared the current credential-scoped cache for {provider}.
catalog.cacheClearAllSuccess: Cleared all model catalog caches for {provider}.
catalog.cacheClearFailed: Failed to clear the model catalog
catalog.credentialRequired: Configure credentials for this provider first.

modelsCapabilities.cloudDescription: Cloud content is read-only. Its local activation and update lifecycle remain part of the single Capability Rules source.
modelsCapabilities.userDescription: User-owned Pack and Rule content participates in the same Capability Rules source after it is committed.
modelsCapabilities.draftDirty: Unsaved changes are kept in the User Rules draft until you save or cancel.
modelsCapabilities.applyConfirmation: Apply this verified candidate? Its content will replace the Cloud snapshot while preserving local activation by stable Rule identity.
modelsCapabilities.inspectorDescription: Inspect separately published source facts for authoritative exact model subjects, and the basis for each resolved Model Fact. This view only shows the resolver's existing conclusions and never re-selects a winner.
modelsCapabilities.resolvedAbsent: No resolved snapshot has been published for this subject yet.
modelsCapabilities.priorityDescription: Set the priority used when Provider Native, models.dev, and Capability Rules make claims about the same exact subject. Equal priorities remain valid and may produce a conflict.

sourcePriority.noTies: No two sources share a priority, so a higher-priority claim always decides.
sourcePriority.tieExplanation: When tied sources disagree about the same fact, no value is selected and the field is shown as a conflict. Use the Conflict filter in the Facts Inspector to find affected fields.
sourcePriority.latestLoaded: Loaded the latest saved version. Your edits are kept; review them and save again.
sourcePriority.loadLatestKeepDraft: Load latest version and keep my edits

validation.notInteger: Use a whole number such as 3 or -1; decimals and text are not allowed.
validation.outOfRange: This number is too large. Use a smaller whole number.

error.staleRevision: Source priority was changed elsewhere after you loaded it, so your save was not applied. Your edits are kept.
error.invalid: The priorities were rejected as invalid. Each source needs a whole number.
error.unavailable: Source priority settings are not available in this window.
error.unknown: Source priority could not be loaded or saved.

modelsCapabilities.noAuthoritativeSubjects: No authoritative exact subjects match this search.
modelsCapabilities.selectSubject: Select an authoritative exact subject to inspect its source facts.
modelsCapabilities.sourceAbsent: No source fact for this subject
modelsCapabilities.noFields: No canonical fields were published for this subject.
modelsCapabilities.selectField: Select a field to inspect its evidence.
modelsCapabilities.rawUnavailable: No persisted raw payload reference is available for this field.

stateExplanation.unsupported: A source explicitly states this capability is not supported.
stateExplanation.unknown: No source made an effective claim, so this cannot be confirmed.
stateExplanation.conflict: Sources with equal priority disagree, and the resolver did not pick a winner.
stateExplanation.data_gap: Source data is missing or invalid, so no conclusion was reached. This does not mean the capability is unsupported.
stateExplanation.no_source_coverage: No source covers this field. This does not mean the capability is unsupported.

selectionReason.no_effective_claim: No source made an effective claim.
selectionReason.single_claim: Only one source made a claim.
selectionReason.lower_priority_fill: A lower-priority source filled in what higher-priority sources did not provide.
selectionReason.explicit_over_derived: At equal priority, an explicit assertion took precedence over a derived one.
selectionReason.partial_supplementation: Several sources each supplied part of the value and were merged.
selectionReason.equal_priority_conflict: Sources with equal priority disagree, which results in a conflict.

control.refreshFailed: The capability check for this model failed ({code}), so availability could not be confirmed.
control.noModelFactsField: No Model Facts field describes this control, so its availability and allowed values are not verified.
control.notInDomain: The resolved Model Facts value does not list this option for this model.
control.notVerifiedExplanation: Allowed values are not verified by Model Facts, so the model may reject a value you enter.
control.unavailableSummary: {count} parameter(s) unavailable for this model. Show advanced to see why.

language.title: Language
language.followSystemDesc: Automatically switch UI language based on system language

credentials.systemCredentialDecryptUnavailable: The API key is saved, but the system secure store cannot currently decrypt it. Re-enter the API key or repair the system secure store and retry.
credentials.systemCredentialRecordInvalid: The saved API key record is invalid. Re-enter the API key.
credentials.secureStorageUnavailableTitle: Linux system secure storage is unavailable
credentials.secureStorageUnavailableBody: Starverse cannot safely persist this API key through the system keyring. You may use it only for this run, or explicitly save it as plaintext in local data.
credentials.plaintextWarning: Plaintext storage means any program able to read Starverse data as the current Linux user may obtain this API key. Do not use it on shared, untrusted, or potentially compromised systems.
credentials.sessionOverridesPersistent: This run only (temporarily overrides saved credential)

runtime.googleAIStudioCredentialStatusUnavailabl: Google AI Studio credential status unavailable.
runtime.googleAIStudioCredentialUpdateFailed: Google AI Studio credential update failed.
runtime.googleAIStudioCredentialClearFailed: Google AI Studio credential clear failed.
runtime.googleAIStudioApiKeyCleared: Google AI Studio API key cleared.
runtime.maxRecentModelsPositiveInteger: maxRecentModels must be a positive integer.
runtime.modelCatalogClearCurrentUnavailable: Model catalog scoped clear is unavailable.
runtime.modelCatalogClearAllUnavailable: Model catalog provider clear is unavailable.

openrouter.title: OpenRouter
openrouter.explicitProviderDesc: OpenRouter is a first-class provider, but it is not an implicit fallback. Select OpenRouter Chat explicitly in Console before sending through OpenRouter.
openrouter.debugEchoDesc: DEV only, stream mode only. Helps diagnose provider parameter mapping.

openAIResponses.title: OpenAI Responses Experimental Chat
openAIResponses.desc: Native OpenAI Responses text-only path. It is separate from OpenRouter, default-off, and uses a main-process credential bridge.
openAIResponses.note: This only updates the experimental OpenAI Responses Console default. Use Console refresh for official availability diagnostics. It does not publish models to the main picker and does not enable chat by itself.

googleAIStudio.title: Google AI Studio Experimental Chat
googleAIStudio.desc: Native Gemini API text-only path. It is separate from OpenRouter, default-off, and uses a main-process credential bridge.
googleAIStudio.note: This only updates the experimental Google AI Studio Console default. Use Console refresh for official availability diagnostics. It does not publish models to the main picker, does not enable chat by itself, and does not use legacy Gemini runtime.

anthropic.title: Anthropic Messages Experimental Chat
anthropic.desc: Native Anthropic Messages text-only path. It is separate from OpenRouter, default-off, and uses a main-process credential bridge.
anthropic.note: This only updates the experimental Anthropic Messages Console default. Use Console refresh for official availability diagnostics. It does not publish models to the main picker, does not enable chat by itself, and does not persist thinking/signature output.

deepSeek.title: DeepSeek Official Experimental Chat
deepSeek.desc: Native DeepSeek official profile using DeepSeek API semantics. It is separate from OpenRouter, default-off, and uses a main-process credential bridge.
deepSeek.note: This only updates the experimental DeepSeek official Console default. Use Console refresh for official availability diagnostics. Deprecated aliases deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner are not long-term primary models. It does not publish models to the main picker, does not enable chat by itself, and does not persist reasoning_content.

localEndpoint.title: Local Endpoint Diagnostics
localEndpoint.desc: Experimental diagnostics only. Text chat requires the explicit LocalEndpoint console mode.
localEndpoint.noModelsFound: no models found; enter a manual model id below
localEndpoint.textCapabilitySummary: Capability summary: text diagnostics only; diagnostics do not activate chat send; tools/files/reasoning/web disabled.
localEndpoint.streamingCapabilitySummary: Capability summary: streaming diagnostics only; diagnostics do not activate chat send; tools/files/reasoning/web disabled.
localEndpoint.chooseProbedModel: Choose probed model for experimental chat
localEndpoint.manualModelForChat: Manual model id for experimental chat
localEndpoint.useEndpointAndModel: Use endpoint and model for experimental chat
localEndpoint.useManualEndpointAndModel: Use manual endpoint and model for experimental chat
localEndpoint.note: This only updates the experimental LocalEndpoint Console defaults. It does not publish models to the main picker and does not enable chat by itself.
localEndpoint.manualNote: Manual override is kept for servers that do not expose a model list. LocalEndpoint remains experimental and default-off.

lmStudio.title: LM Studio Local
lmStudio.experimentalLabel: LM Studio Local · native REST controls · loopback only
lmStudio.boundarySummary: Loopback-only text chat; native REST controls are separate from chat mode.
lmStudio.bridgeUnavailable: LM Studio provider bridge is unavailable.

ollama.title: Ollama Local
ollama.experimentalLabel: Ollama Local · native REST control plane · loopback only
ollama.boundarySummary: Loopback-only text chat; load/unload use the native control plane and never download models.

network.title: Network Experiments
network.proxyPolicyDesc: Plugin downloads use this policy. Automatic and conversion-time downloads remain disabled.
network.strictSslRequired: Strict SSL required for plugin downloads
network.currentModeProbeDesc: Current mode: {mode}. Probe checks metadata, HEAD and a 1 KB Range request only.
network.streamInMainDesc: Use IPC + electron.net for SSE (enables keepalive/force HTTP/1.1)
network.copyRunReportDesc: Copy a run report for A/B debugging.

reasoning.hint: Defaults apply to non-project sessions. Session-level preferences override project/global defaults.
reasoning.inlineDefaultDesc: Controls whether new assistant inline reasoning opens expanded.
reasoning.userMessageRichDesc: Default for sessions in follow mode.
reasoning.recentModelsLimitDesc: Controls the Model Picker Rec list.
